alternatives.option: Rewrite the memo body in place
alternatives.reason_rejected: the memo was already sent; a rewritten body is history rewriting and the field's own standard treats it as a stale literal

context: Field-response A-batch complete: Doc 2 (wave-2 verification response), Doc 3 (routing-upstream response), prepared GitHub issues (NOT filed), send wrapper, memo/memo-send errata appends — all adversarially reviewed and controller-verified; committing.
rationale: Pathspec restores create no commit and move no HEAD, and mid-session ingest re-ingests only on HEAD movement (sync-manager.ts:64-91), so the revert lands at the next ingest after a later HEAD move — git log -p can never show it. Append-only errata keeps the sent memo's body byte-stable (the field retrieves it by curl from main).
summary: D14 closed as field-confirmed (2026-08-17 reply): the field accepts the file-wins record-level revert mechanism and withdraws its override-no-op causal story; our git-log-p diagnostic instruction is conceded as structurally unusable and the ship memo carries a dated Errata block instead of a body rewrite
